item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 30/Mar/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now affecting the coast of southern China is moderating gradually. A cold front is expected to reach Guangdong on Friday. It will be windy with temperatures falling appreciably over the region. The weather will be rather cool with some rain from Saturday to Sunday morning. Under the influence of a relatively dry continental airstream, the weather will be mainly fine over the coast of southern China early to midweek next week.

Date/Month: 31/03 (Thursday)
Wind: East force 3 to 4.
Weather: Sunny periods. Rather warm during the day. Mist at night.
Temp range: 20 - 26 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
